title: Applicant Record
description: One retained applicant's persisted data for one season. See specs/001-scraper-persistence/data-model.md and specs/002-map-generator/data-model.md for field-by-field write rules.

match_key.description: normalize(first_name)-normalize(last_name); also the filename stem. Immutable once created.

last_name.description: Empty when the intranet has no last name on file for this person (a Name cell with no separator to split one out of).

role.description: Raw participation role text as scraped from the intranet applicant table's Role column (e.g. "Rider", "Service Crew", "Supporter"), or null if not yet known.

birthday.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD), or null if not yet known.

status.description: Application status text as first observed. Frozen at creation; never rewritten by later scrapes.

excluded.description: Set true, once, the first time a later scrape observes status "no" for this non-ignored record.

excluded_observed_at.description: Set together with excluded: true. Null while excluded is false.

ignore.description: Manual-only flag. The scraper reads but never writes this field.

photo.description: Path to the photo file, relative to the season folder, e.g. "photos/jane-doe.jpg". Null until a photo fetch succeeds.

latitude.description: Geocoded from address by scripts/generate_member_maps.py (002-map-generator). Null until a geocode lookup succeeds. Set once, fill-empty-only — never rewritten by a later run once non-null (Principle III); always set together with longitude.

longitude.description: Geocoded from address by scripts/generate_member_maps.py (002-map-generator). Null until a geocode lookup succeeds. Set once, fill-empty-only — never rewritten by a later run once non-null (Principle III); always set together with latitude.
